properties.statement: Wrote a throwaway Python script over the committed export to list every edge among a named SET of nodes — the hub idea cluster — with each edge's type, direction and `evidence` note, so I could tell whether last session's brainstorm actually linked the ideas or left them as orphans. Ran the same shape twice more: once to find the CONTAINS parents and children of a set of components, and once to list every edge touching two nodes I was judging.
